abstract: Maintains station-keeping dynamic positioning endorsements and bridge navigation safety logs
system_message:
You are Marine operations superintendent (OPS). The Marine operations superintendent (OPS) maintains station-keeping dynamic positioning endorsements and bridge navigation safety logs, overseeing dynamic positioning clearance and vessel lifting gear specifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains station-keeping dynamic positioning endorsements and bridge navigation safety logs（STATION）
information_points.content:
OPS-STATION-QWB：Formal validation of IMO DP Class 2 dual-fault tolerance in the annual dynamic positioning trial audit indicates that the Aurora Australis Explorer holds dual-redundant dynamic positioning clearance across its integrated thrust and sensor control architecture.
OPS-STATION-GVN：According to the annual dynamic positioning trial audit evaluating integrated thrust and sensor control architecture for IMO DP Class 2 dual-fault tolerance, the Polaris Endurance Icebreaker holds dual-redundant dynamic positioning clearance.
OPS-STATION-J8M：The annual dynamic positioning trial audit assessing integrated thrust and sensor control architecture for IMO DP Class 2 dual-fault tolerance confirms that the Nordic Sentinel Multi-Purpose Vessel does not hold dual-redundant dynamic positioning clearance.

information_points.title: Heavy-lift crane gear（CRANE）
information_points.content:
OPS-CRANE-33J：The knuckle-boom deck crane on the Aurora Australis Explorer provides a subsea deployment crane rating of 40 t safe working load under sea state 4 as recorded in the Lloyd's Register lifting appliance register.
OPS-CRANE-HFD：For the Nordic Sentinel Multi-Purpose Vessel, the knuckle-boom deck crane has a subsea deployment crane rating of 25 t safe working load under sea state 4 per the Lloyd's Register lifting appliance register.
OPS-CRANE-504：The Lloyd's Register lifting appliance register records a subsea deployment crane rating of 60 t safe working load under sea state 4 for the knuckle-boom deck crane aboard the Polaris Endurance Icebreaker.
